parse.title: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos
parse.text: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos (also known as UFC Fight Night 289 and UFC Vegas 121) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on September 26, 2026, at the Meta Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.[2]
